drop.name: withdraw_fair
drop.why: duplicate of withdraw_fair_custom, and its 'assets' param is the bare mapping MockToken.balanceOf with no key (A0), so its meaning is ambiguous

fix.name: withdraw_fair_custom
fix.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and ((pre("totalLiquidity") == 0 and post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) < pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) or wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalLiquidity")) > wide(arg(0)) * wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)))
fix.why: withdraw pays at most liquidity/total of the pool; with zero total liquidity nobody holds a claim, so nothing may be paid (the old form evaluated 0 > 0 and missed this case)

fix.name: no_third_party_token_loss
fix.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and not called("MockToken.transferFrom") and post("MockToken.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken.balanceOf", u)
fix.why: nobody loses tokens in others' calls; direct MockToken.transferFrom by an approved spender is legitimate and excluded

add.name: withdraw_payout_to_sender
add.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and sender != A0 and post("MockToken.balanceOf", sender) - pre("MockToken.balanceOf", sender) != pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)
add.why: whatever leaves the vault on withdraw goes to the caller
